prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1058; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the type and force of the impact, and the presenting shoulder complaints fit well with that mechanism. Over the course of eight visits, the patient received conservative management including physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction. Course of care ran somewhat longer than is typical for this injury pattern, which we attribute in part to a pre-existing shoulder condition treated within the past two years that continues to contribute to current symptoms. On examination, several findings support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including limited active elevation and tenderness along the rotator cuff insertion. Other tests, including neurovascular screening and strength testing in the distal extremity, returned normal results. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicated or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing improvement is expected with continued home program adherence, with reassessment planned if symptoms do not continue to resolve.
